Our story

The 499 Store is a clothing and footwear store in Dashmesh Market, Sector 119, Balongi, Mohali. Shirts, polos, jackets, jeans and a wall of shoes and sneakers sit together in one warm, easy space. The idea is simple: good-looking everyday fashion without the overwhelming mall.

The details you'll remember

Dark green walls, walnut-toned counters, a polka-dot feature wall, a brick wall of shoes, and a monkey lamp swinging over the jackets. He's our signature.

Style for everyone

Formal, casual and sporty, all in reach.

Honest, friendly service

Real help with sizes and fits.

Fresh arrivals

Racks that keep changing.
